I have been trying to make a scatter plot with errorbars. I have a
seperate list of errors for each corresponding point. I know if order
to plot the errorbars I need use a function in ggplot and give the
limits for error.

the "can't evaluate class uneval" error. I have been struggling with

Any help will be much appreciated
